title: An Inner Watch-Den
summary: A warm, cramped den littered with thick wolf-pelts and hardened clay bowls. The floor vibrates with the shaman's drumming, and chalk markings cover the bedding wall.

features.inspect_text: A collection of thick hide bundles and carved bone amulets, dusted with fine lime chalk.

title: A Curing Vault

inspect_text: Heavy, pungent smoke curls around drying frames loaded with salted venison and strips of hide. The center stone is stained black with resin and animal grease. Through the smoke, the rhythmic thud of the staff sounds directly through the opening: TOCK… TOCK.

features.label: the gutting stone
features.inspect_text: A massive dressing slab, dark and greasy, flanked by neat rows of flint wedges and bone carving chisels.

title: The Convergence of Tracks
summary: The patrolling channels deepen here, cut thick into stone and dusted with white chalk. They lead straight toward the central glow, and each strike of the shaman's staff vibrates hard through the floor.
inspect_text: All the tracks of the floor seem to gather here. Four deep channels converge at clean perpendiculars, their edges powdered white with stray chalk. The air is dry and hot against your face. Every few seconds, the floor shudders with a dull, heavy thump: TOCK. Something massive is striking stone just beyond.

features.inspect_text: Deep grooves converging like lines on a grid, whitened by chalk dust dragged in on small feet.

title: The Work-Ring
summary: The deepest chamber on this level. A wide circle of chalk glows on the cave floor — the same pale light as your own lines — and inside it, golems stand unfinished: a shoulder, a head with no seams yet, slabs of raw rock. The air is thick with ash and hot clay.
inspect_text: You stop at the edge of a wide chalk circle drawn on the cave floor, glowing the same pale light as the lines you draw yourself. Inside it, golems are being made: a shoulder of dark volcanic rock, a head still without seams, slabs of raw stone waiting to be given a shape. The air tastes of ash and hot clay and burned herbs. At the ring’s center the goblin shaman works, hunched and patient, one pale hand pressed flat to the stone. Tock. Tock. A staff beating slow time against the floor.

descriptions.summary: The chalk ring lies scuffed and broken underfoot. The half-made golems stand unfinished, and there is no hand to finish them now. Only ash, and the cold smoke of an untended fire.
descriptions.inspect_text: The work-ring’s chalk is scuffed and broken under your feet. Half-made golems stand the way they were left — a shoulder, a seamless head, slabs of raw rock — and the dying fire twists one last thread of smoke at the room’s center. The air has gone still and cold.

features.label: the chalk ring
features.inspect_text: A circle of chalk drawn on the cave floor, wide enough to stand in, glowing the pale color of your own marks. It is the largest of its kind you have seen.

title: A Glowing Crucible Chamber

inspect_text: The room stinks of old kill. Fire-scorch runs up the walls; a low flat stone in the middle is black and greasy with a thousand dressings; strips of meat hang from a frame, drying in the smoke. Flies buzz in a corner. Something here was living, and not long ago.

features.label: the gutting stone
features.inspect_text: A slab of rock worn black and smooth at its center, where the tribe dresses its kills. The smell is richest here.

title: The Convergence of Tracks
summary: The patrolling channels deepen here, cut thick into stone and dusted with white chalk. They lead straight toward the central glow, and each strike of the shaman's staff vibrates hard through the floor.
inspect_text: All the tracks of the floor seem to gather here. Four deep channels converge at clean perpendiculars, their edges powdered white with stray chalk. The air is dry and hot against your face. Every few seconds, the floor shudders with a dull, heavy thump: TOCK. Something massive is striking stone just beyond.

features.label: the worn crossing tracks
features.inspect_text: Deep grooves converging like lines on a grid, whitened by chalk dust dragged in on small feet.

title: A Glowing Crucible Chamber
summary: A wide pit of white-hot coals throbs with dry, baking heat. The stone walls are glazed red, and the air smells intensely of scorched clay and burned herbs.
inspect_text: Baking heat hits your chest like a wall. A wide stone trough glows with banked, white-hot embers that cast leaping shadows up the jagged ceiling. The air tastes bitter with chalk dust and burned mountain-sage. From the adjacent opening, the rhythm of the staff sounds close enough to touch: TOCK.

features.label: the ember pit
features.inspect_text: A heavy stone trough glowing white and cherry-red, radiating fierce heat that makes the air shimmer.

title: An Inner Watch-Den
summary: A warm, cramped den littered with thick wolf-pelts and hardened clay bowls. The floor vibrates with the shaman's drumming, and chalk markings cover the bedding wall.
inspect_text: Thick predator pelts line the floor, warm from recent bodies. The air is pungent with animal musk and hot grease. Scored into the stone behind the beds are chalk rings and tallies, identical in spacing to the marks on your own knuckles. The staff strikes stone nearby: tock… tock.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A collection of thick hide bundles and carved bone amulets, dusted with fine lime chalk.

title: A Cold Fire-Pit Chamber
summary: A low circle of blackened stones holds a bed of sluggish, dying embers. A cold draft from a chimney overhead flattens the smoke, and the room smells of damp soot and wet earth.
inspect_text: A circle of river stones surrounds a bed of embers struggling against a downdraft. The smoke is thin and cold, sucked toward a fissure in the rock above. You warm your hands a second above the faint orange glow; the heat barely cuts through the cave's chill.

features.label: the ember pit
features.inspect_text: Blackened river stones ringed around grey ash and dying orange coals. The stones are cold to the touch on their outer rim.

title: An Outer Den
summary: A low, drafty alcove where old pelts are piled against damp stone. The smell of cold musk and sour straw hangs in the air, and a small heap of gnawed bird-bones sits in the corner.
inspect_text: You have to stoop. The ceiling drops low over a scatter of moldering hides and stiff furs. A cold seep drips slowly down the back wall, plinking into a stone puddle. In the driest corner, small rodent bones lie arranged in neat little stacks of five—someone here counted them.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A small pile of dry, gnawed bones, sorted by size into neat little bundles.

title: A Scavenge Ground
summary: A cold cavern room littered with splintered bones and dried sinew. A low dressing rock sits under a chimney draft, smelling of old, dried blood and wet slate.
inspect_text: The air is cold and smells of dried sinew and stale blood. A flat limestone slab in the corner is gouged by rough flint scrapers, its surface stained dark. A draft pulls the smell away into high cracks, leaving the chamber stark and quiet.

features.label: the gutting stone
features.inspect_text: A flat limestone rock scarred by scraping blades, surrounded by dry shavings of antler and bone.

title: A Guarded Crossing
summary: A golem of dark volcanic rock, lumped and broad stands in the middle of the room, broad as a closed door, watching nothing. The floor around it is swept clean, and the air is the quietest on this level.
inspect_text: In the center of the room a golem of dark volcanic rock, lumped and broad stands still as furniture — no mouth, eyes of flat polished pebble, a pale chalk ring circling its chest and brow. It does not react to you. The room smells of cold stone and chalk dust, and small feet have kept clear of it for a long, long time.

features.label: the chalk-ring mark
features.inspect_text: A pale chalk ring is marked on the golem’s chest and brow, in the same pale light as the frost on the sleeping wall.

title: A Fire-Pit Chamber
summary: A shallow pit of embers glows in the middle of the floor, ringed with stones scored black by long use. Smoke layers flat against the ceiling like a low roof, and the room is warm enough to sweat in.
inspect_text: Heat meets you at the doorway. A shallow pit of embers throbs low in the center of the room, its ring of stones scarred by a thousand proddings with a fire-stick. The smoke hangs in a flat layer overhead, and your shadow stretches long across the floor. It smells of ash and old grease.

features.label: the ember pit
features.inspect_text: A ring of fire-scarred stones, and inside it embers that never quite die out. The coals breathe, orange and patient.

title: A Den
summary: A low-ceilinged den, thick with old hides and fur. A fire has burned down to ash against one wall, and gnawed bones are stacked neatly in a corner. The air is heavy with damp fur and musk.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A neat stack of long bones, gnawed clean and arranged almost carelessly — the way you’d tidy something you might want again.

title: The Mushroom Grove
summary: A cavern floor is choked with pale mushrooms, all leaning toward the glowing canopy above. The air smells of wet earth and something sweet, like crushed fruit.
inspect_text: Pale mushrooms crowd the floor, every cap leaning toward the glowing canopy above. The air holds wet earth and something sweet — crushed fruit, or a thing that ripened down here.

features.label: the pale mushrooms
features.inspect_text: Cluster after cluster of knee-high mushrooms sprout from the moist cave soil. Their pale spongy caps all lean uniformly toward the canopy above, as if turning toward a subterranean sun.

features.label: the glowing canopy
features.inspect_text: High above, living roots knit into an expansive vaulted ceiling woven with luminescent lichen and moss. A soft teal glow filters down through the gloom.

title: A Glowing Clearing
summary: A wide clearing lit by drifting spores that pulse slowly, like a heartbeat. Overhead a false sky shimmers, bright enough to read by, wrong enough to notice.
inspect_text: Spores drift across this clearing at a slow, even pulse, lighting the ground beneath your feet. Above, a false sky shimmers faintly — steady enough to read by, wrong enough that you notice.

features.label: the drifting spores
features.inspect_text: Glittering spores drift through the still air in lazy arcs, pulsing brighter and dimmer on an even, four-second cadence like a slow subterranean breath.

features.label: the false sky
features.inspect_text: The cavern ceiling shimmers like an artificial twilight sky. It offers just enough illumination to cast sharp shadows and reveal the path ahead.

title: The Root Tangle
summary: Great roots as thick as your arm weave through the walls here, and between them the forest breathes in and out. Somewhere at the edge of your hearing, something keeps time with it.
inspect_text: Great roots lace the walls and ceiling here, and between them the quiet forest breathes. You listen for a moment; somewhere in the dark, something answers on the same slow rhythm.

features.label: the root tangle
features.inspect_text: Gnarled roots as thick as your torso twist through cracks in the stone walls. They pulse with faint sap-warmth, flexing almost imperceptibly against the rock.

features.label: the living walls
features.inspect_text: Limestone blocks split by ancient wood. Cool water weeps down the fissures, feeding dense coats of dark moss.

title: A Still Pool Glade

features.label: the still pool

features.label: the ripples

title: The Fungus Hollow
summary: Across the hollow, mushrooms stand like sentinels, each near the height of your knee, planted in even ranks. Their caps throw pale light across the stone.
inspect_text: Pale light falls across the hollow from a hundred mushroom caps, each set evenly apart like a field that was planted on purpose. The light is cool and steady, good enough to see by.

features.label: the sentinel mushrooms
features.inspect_text: Stout mushrooms stand in orderly, grid-like rows across the damp earth. Their flat caps cast pale rings of light onto the soil like miniature lanterns.

features.label: the spore light
features.inspect_text: Cool phosphorescence emanating from beneath the mushroom gills, lighting up the soil in quiet pools.

title: A Chalked Trail
summary: Faint chalk lines run along the floor at your feet, worn almost to nothing, leading deeper into the dark. Someone drew a path here long ago and left it.
inspect_text: Thin chalk lines run ahead of you along the stone, worn to ghosts of their old marks. They keep to the center of the passage and lead deeper, as if someone once walked this way often.

features.label: the chalk trail
features.inspect_text: Thin white lines drawn with ancient mineral chalk trace the floor down the center of the lane. They have faded over decades of foot traffic, yet the geometry remains straight and deliberate.

features.label: the worn marks
features.inspect_text: Faint geometric intersections scored into the bedrock. Someone mapped this corridor with precision long before you walked it.

title: The Whispering Ferns
summary: Fern-like growths as tall as your shoulder line the walls, rustling though there is no wind. They whisper in a language that sounds almost familiar.
inspect_text: Tall fern-shaped growths line the walls on both sides, and they murmur without any wind to move them. The sound is almost language, almost your name, never quite either.

features.label: the whispering ferns
features.inspect_text: Towering fronds as tall as your shoulder rustle against each other in dry, rhythmic sibilance. In the rustling you catch fragments that sound uncannily like whispered syllables.

features.label: the rustling sound
features.inspect_text: The fronds move without wind, swaying in gentle synchrony with the breathing of the root-canopy.

title: A Shaft of Sky
summary: A crack in the cavern roof opens far above, and through it falls a light like starlight, pooling onto a bed of moss. You tilt your head back to watch it.
inspect_text: Far above, a crack in the roof lets in a column of pale light that pools on the moss by your feet. It is the first true light you have seen down here, and it is very old.

features.label: the shaft of sky
features.inspect_text: A sheer chimney cut into the vault far above. Through it falls a clean, vertical beam of silver starlight, cutting through the damp mist like a spear.

features.label: the moss bed
features.inspect_text: A thick velvet carpet of emerald moss thriving directly in the beam of starlight. It is cool and resilient beneath your boots.

summary: A crack in the cavern roof opens far above, and through it falls a light like starlight, pooling onto a bed of moss. You tilt your head back to watch it.
inspect_text: Far above, a crack in the roof lets in a column of pale light that pools on the moss by your feet. It is the first true light you have seen down here, and it is very old.

features.label: the shaft of sky
features.inspect_text: A sheer chimney cut into the vault far above. Through it falls a clean, vertical beam of silver starlight, cutting through the damp mist like a spear.

features.label: the moss bed
features.inspect_text: A thick velvet carpet of emerald moss thriving directly in the beam of starlight. It is cool and resilient beneath your boots.

title: The Deep Glade
summary: The air here is still and old, and the hum of this forest is loudest at your back. Glowing vines hang around you like curtains, their light slow and steady.
inspect_text: Still, old air lines this glade, and the forest hum is loudest here. Curtains of glowing vine hang heavy around you, their light riding the same slow pulse as the spores of the outer woods.

features.label: the glowing vines
features.inspect_text: Thick curtains of braided vine hang from the boughs like tapestries. Their pale teal veins throb in time with the forest's deep pulse.

features.label: the forest hum
features.inspect_text: A low vibration that thrums in your teeth and chest. The deep roots of the back rank anchor the entire cavern.

title: The King's Grove
summary: The forest parts into a wide, still chamber. At its heart, enthroned in roots and pale light, sits the elf king, watching the entrance — watching you.
inspect_text: The trees open at last into a wide, still chamber. In a throne woven of roots and pale light sits the elf king, and he is looking at the entrance, at you, with no hurry at all.

descriptions.summary: The forest opens into a wide, still chamber. Where the elf king once sat enthroned in roots and pale light, only a hollowed throne of grey bark remains.
descriptions.inspect_text: The forest opens into a wide, still chamber. Where the elf king once sat enthroned in roots and pale light, only a hollowed throne of grey bark remains.

features.label: the root throne
features.inspect_text: A grand seat grown seamlessly out of living ash-grey roots and curled bark. Ancient carvings mark its high backrest, worn smooth by centuries of royal repose.

features.label: the pale light
features.inspect_text: A concentrated corona of silver-green illumination bathing the center of the grove, undisturbed by drafts or smoke.

title: The North Offering
summary: A great dish of black glass stands against the north wall like an open mouth, gathering the ring that circles the board toward it.
inspect_text: The store of the board: where the gathered stones were poured and counted. The glass around it is cool, but you know the heat this room was made to hold.

features.label: the fire-bowl
features.inspect_text: A wide dish of black glass, deep as a man's chest. Its lip is scored where embers have been poured in and cleared away a thousand times.

features.label: the black glass
features.inspect_text: Sheets of polished volcanic glass form the foundation of the north store, cool and slick beneath your boots.

title: The South Store
summary: The ring bends south into a second dish, shallower than the first, and at its bottom a single ember smoulders.
inspect_text: The far store of the board. One seed has been left behind — warm, steady, waiting for a hand to move it.

features.label: the fire-bowl
features.inspect_text: A wide dish of black glass. A single ember smoulders at its bottom, the last seed of the south store.

features.label: the banked ember
features.inspect_text: A stubborn node of cherry-red heat pulsing softly in the soot of the south store.

title: A Basin of Cooling Embers
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. In its center a broad depression holds one red coal that never quite dies.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. A single coal breathes in the depression, skirted by black glass. It does not warm the room — only the memory of warmth.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: A single coal breathes in the depression, skirted by black glass. It does not warm the room — only the memory of warmth.

features.label: the thermal cracks
features.inspect_text: Hairline fractures spiderweb through the black glass floor, radiating dull warmth from heat chambers below.

title: A Basin of Kept Embers
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. A film of embers lies over the glass, caught like seeds before sowing.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Tiny embers fleck the floor like a scatter of seed, slightly warmer under the fingers than the surrounding glass.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: Tiny embers fleck the floor like a scatter of seed, slightly warmer under the fingers than the surrounding glass.

features.label: the thermal cracks

title: A Basin Between Two Stores
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. Two faint lines of carved glass race away to either hand, joining the ring at the far store.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Two scored lines run out of this chamber and vanish around the curve of the ring.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: Two scored lines run out of this chamber and vanish around the curve of the ring.

features.label: the thermal cracks
features.inspect_text: Hairline fractures spiderweb through the black glass floor, radiating dull warmth from heat chambers below.

title: A Basin of Ashen Glass
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. The bowl is cracked and cold, its stones pale as ash.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The crack runs through the center of the bowl. Whatever burned here has long been taken.

features.label: the glass basin

features.label: the thermal cracks

title: A Basin That Remembers Fire
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. A dull warmth rises through the floor, here at the board's one true hearth.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Heat wells up gently through the seams. Beneath, you sense the same dead fire you have felt all along: banked, waiting.

title: A Basin Near the South Store
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. The ring bends south toward a tall dark offering dish.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The southern store is a tall column of shadow on the rim, its dish holding the last of the board's gathered light.

features.label: the glass basin

features.label: the thermal cracks

title: A Basin of the Turning Board
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. The glass underfoot is worn to a shine, as if countless stones were slid across it.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The floor is glass worn mirror-smooth, the recorded arc of a thousand unseen moves.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: The floor is glass worn mirror-smooth, the recorded arc of a thousand unseen moves.

features.label: the ash drifts
features.inspect_text: Fine grey soot and volcanic silt collected in the corners and grooves of the basin, shifting under draft and footstep.

title: A Basin Where Seeds Were Slid
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. A scatter of seed-shaped embers sits in the bowl, none of them lit.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Embers sit one by one, evenly spaced, exactly as seeds would be set out before a game.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: Embers sit one by one, evenly spaced, exactly as seeds would be set out before a game.

features.label: the ash drifts
features.inspect_text: Fine grey soot and volcanic silt collected in the corners and grooves of the basin, shifting under draft and footstep.

title: A Basin of Deep Stillness
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. Nothing moves. The stillness here is older than the black glass itself.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The air is cold and still. Even the ancient warmth of the board does not reach here.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: The air is cold and still. Even the ancient warmth of the board does not reach here.

features.label: the ash drifts

title: A Basin of the Long Ring
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. The ring stretches long in both directions, one arc fading into gloom.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The ring doubles back on itself for a long way before either store or center appears.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: The ring doubles back on itself for a long way before either store or center appears.

features.label: the ash drifts

title: A Basin on the Far Arc
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. Far across the dark, the heart of the board glows a faint, banked orange.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Across the dark the heart-pit burns at a steady, unhurried orange.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: Across the dark the heart-pit burns at a steady, unhurried orange.

features.label: the ash drifts

title: A Basin at the North Store
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. Northward, a monumental bowl gathers the ring into itself.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The north store's dish shelves up beyond the rim, its mouth drinking the ring.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: The north store's dish shelves up beyond the rim, its mouth drinking the ring.

features.label: the ash drifts
features.inspect_text: Fine grey soot and volcanic silt collected in the corners and grooves of the basin, shifting under draft and footstep.

title: The Heart-Pit
summary: The ring's center opens into a shallow pit of black glass, and in it, on a cradle of embers, a fire burns — patient, watchful, alone.
inspect_text: The ring's center opens into a shallow pit of black glass. In the cradle, a clot of embers holds to a deep, steady heat. Something in it watches the edge of the pit.

descriptions.summary: The heart-pit is empty. Where the Fire Elemental burned, only a round cradle of black glass remains, still warm, holding a faint spiral of ash.
descriptions.inspect_text: The heart of the board is a shallow pit of black glass. Where the Fire Elemental burned, only a round cradle remains, still warm, holding a faint spiral of ash.

features.label: the coals
features.inspect_text: In the cradle of the pit, a clot of embers burns with a deep, steady heat. It does not crackle. It does not spread. It simply holds.

features.label: the obsidian cradle
features.inspect_text: A sunken saucer of seamless black glass engineered to concentrate the cavern's elemental heat at its center.

title: Northwest Watchtower
summary: A tall wooden platform looking out over the dark cave ceiling. Cold drafts blow down from cracks in the stone roof.
inspect_text: Wooden braces hold up a sturdy catwalk twenty feet above the fort floor. Crossbow bolts lie ready in open wooden bins.

features.label: the wooden catwalk
features.inspect_text: Planks of heavy pine nailed across oak beams, looking down across the fortified camp.

title: West Stockade Wall
summary: A solid line of pointed pine logs backed by dirt mounds. Soldiers patrol the packed dirt walkway below.
inspect_text: The wall separates the soldiers from the cold, dark western caves where no one goes.

features.label: the packed dirt rampart
features.inspect_text: Firm earth packed between timber retaining walls, creating an elevated walkway.

title: Southwest Watchtower
summary: A timber watchtower looking south toward the village roofs and north into the soldiers' yard.
inspect_text: A spiral ladder leads up to the watch platform. A brass horn hangs ready to call the garrison to arms.

features.label: the brass horn
features.inspect_text: A curved brass war horn used to signal shift changes and sound the alarm.

title: High Stone Overlook
summary: A rocky ledge high above the village roofs. You can see the pale yellow lantern lights of town below.
inspect_text: The cave wall curves sharply here. Cool water drips into a small mossy pool from cracks in the ceiling.

features.label: the mossy drip pool
features.inspect_text: A clear stone basin filled with cold runoff water, edged with pale green lichen.

title: Upper Residential Terrace
summary: A quiet stone terrace where several elder families have their homes. Low stone walls border the walkway.
inspect_text: Flowerpots made of hollowed river rocks hold pale subterranean flowers that open in the dark.

features.label: the stone flowerpots
features.inspect_text: Rough stone cups growing small white cave blossoms that smell faintly like vanilla.

title: The Elder's Hut
summary: A small, tidy stone hut lined with shelves of old village records. A stone hearth burns low in the corner.
inspect_text: Elder Valen sits at a low pine table, looking at an official scroll sealed with red temple wax. His hands tremble slightly, and he looks exhausted and guilty.

features.label: the elder's table
features.inspect_text: A heavy pine table covered in rosters of villagers. A temple document with a broken wax seal lies open in the center.

title: Miner Cottage Row West
summary: A row of neat stone cottages built right into hollows in the cavern wall. Small wooden fences enclose little yards.
inspect_text: Lines of washed clothes hang between stone pillars. An old woman sits on a bench mending a wool jacket.

features.label: the clothesline
features.inspect_text: Hemp rope strung between stone pins, holding drying wool work shirts and denim trousers.

title: Quiet Cul-de-sac
summary: A quiet dead-end alley between steep stone walls. Solitary stone benches offer a place to think.
inspect_text: A faint draft of warm air rises from fissures in the stone. Small bats roost high in the ceiling cracks.

features.label: the stone bench
features.inspect_text: A slab of slate resting on two granite blocks, worn smooth by generations of quiet resting.

title: Clean Water Spring
summary: A natural freshwater spring bubbling up through a fracture in white limestone rock.
inspect_text: The water is crystal clear and ice cold. Moss and pale green water-cress grow around the pool's stone lip.

features.label: the bubbling spring
features.inspect_text: A natural spring pouring dozens of gallons of pure water every minute into a natural stone basin.

title: South Cliff Basin
summary: The southwestern-most corner of the cavern. The rock wall drops into an old natural chasm below.
inspect_text: A sturdy timber railing prevents anyone from slipping over the edge. Cool air drafts upward from unseen depths.

features.label: the cliff edge railing
features.inspect_text: Double timber rails bolted into iron eyelets anchored deep into the cliff bedrock.

title: West Rampart Walk
summary: A high walkway behind sharpened log palisades. Sentry shields hang against the wooden rail.
inspect_text: Torches set in iron hoops light the perimeter wall. Soldiers can patrol along this plank floor to spot trouble from afar.

features.label: the sharpened palisade logs
features.inspect_text: Thick tree trunks stripped of bark and carved to sharp points, lashed tight with thick hemp ropes.

title: West Soldier Barracks
summary: A long wooden building lined with double-deck bunk beds and straw mattresses. Off-duty soldiers sleep or play cards.
inspect_text: Wool blankets are piled on the beds. The room smells of stale sweat, leather wax, and pipe smoke.

features.label: the row of bunks
features.inspect_text: Simple pine bunk beds with rough wool blankets folded at the foot of each mattress.

title: Camp Smithy
summary: A smoky open-air workshop with a roaring stone furnace and a heavy iron anvil.
inspect_text: The camp blacksmith pounds out glowing iron shoes for mules and straightens damaged spear tips. Sparks shower over the dirt floor.

features.label: the heavy iron anvil
features.inspect_text: A massive black anvil ringed with hammer marks, anchored firmly to a thick oak stump.

title: North Cave Ledge
summary: A narrow stone path winding along the north cave wall. Stone handrails have been carved into the living rock.
inspect_text: Looking down, you can see smoke rising from village hearths. The air smells of wood ash and clean stone.

features.label: the carved handrail
features.inspect_text: Smooth rock carved by decades of miners' hands walking along the upper path.

title: Carved Stone Steps
summary: Broad stone stairs cut straight into the natural bedrock, linking the upper terrace to the streets below.
inspect_text: The center of each step is worn smooth and concave from thousands of boots climbing up and down.

features.label: the worn steps
features.inspect_text: Heavy stone steps smoothed down by generations of miners walking home from long shifts.

title: The Village Hall
summary: A large wooden hall built against the natural rock wall. Long benches and tables fill the room, where miners eat soup together after long shifts.
inspect_text: The air smells of mushroom soup, wood smoke, and damp wool. An iron soup kettle hangs over a central fire pit. Villagers sit in small groups, whispering angrily about Kip's arrest.

features.label: the central fire pit
features.inspect_text: A wide stone circle filled with glowing embers. A giant black iron kettle bubbles with hot mushroom and bean broth.

title: Bess's Bakery
summary: A warm, inviting stone cottage with a domed brick oven built into the rock wall. Fresh mushroom bread cools on pine shelves.
inspect_text: Bess the baker stands by the counter with flour on her apron. Her eyes are red from crying about Kip. The smell of sweet yeast and toasted grain fills the room.

features.label: the domed brick oven
features.inspect_text: A large rounded oven with glowing embers inside, baking loaves of dark, hearty cave bread.

title: Village School Room
summary: A simple wooden room with rows of low desks and slate boards where village children learn to read and calculate.
inspect_text: Chalk sticks and slate erasers sit in wooden trays. A painted chart on the wall shows different types of rocks and crystals.

features.label: the mineral wall chart
features.inspect_text: A linen poster showing drawings of iron ore, granite, quartz, and glowing mana crystals.

title: Communal Wash Basin
summary: A long stone trough fed by the spring runoff where villagers wash work shirts, blankets, and iron pots.
inspect_text: Wooden washboards and bars of brown tallow soap sit on the stone ledge. The water flows clean toward the south drain.

features.label: the stone wash trough
features.inspect_text: A thirty-foot stone channel cut with grooves where laundry is scrubbed clean.

title: Miner Memorial Stones
summary: A quiet alcove where dozens of small slate stones have been set into the cave wall.
inspect_text: Each stone is carved with the name of a miner who died in cave-ins or gas leaks over the past sixty years. Small tallow candles burn in front of many stones.

features.label: the carved memorial stones
features.inspect_text: Dozens of small slate tablets etched with names, dates, and pickaxe emblems to honor fallen workers.

title: North Patrol Post
summary: A sheltered alcove on the north wall where sentries rest between patrol shifts.
inspect_text: A small charcoal brazier keeps the guard post warm. Scratched game boards are cut into the bench where off-duty soldiers play dice.

features.label: the charcoal brazier
features.inspect_text: An iron dish glowing with red coals that keep off the chill of the north cavern.

title: Camp Mess Hall
summary: Long trestle tables and benches fill this wooden hall. Iron pots bubble over an open hearth.
inspect_text: Soldiers eat hot mutton stew and fresh bread here. The room smells of roasted grease, garlic, and spilled beer.

features.label: the big stew pot
features.inspect_text: A three-legged iron cauldron bubbling with potatoes, salt meat, and root vegetables.

title: Archery Practice Yard
summary: Straw target dummies stuffed with dried grass stand against a tall mound of dirt.
inspect_text: Dozens of splintered crossbow bolts stick out from the wooden targets. Guards practice their aim here every morning.

features.label: the straw targets
features.inspect_text: Human-shaped targets woven from tough mountain straw, pocked with crossbow holes.

title: North Cliff Path
summary: A broad gravel path sloping downward toward the village streets. Small lanterns hang from iron spikes in the rock.
inspect_text: The path is well-traveled, swept clear of loose stones so walking miners will not twist their ankles.

features.label: the iron spike lanterns
features.inspect_text: Small tin lanterns burning tallow candles, casting warm circles of light on the gravel.

title: North Village Street
summary: A cobblestone lane lined with modest stone huts. Pale curtains hang in the windows of miner homes.
inspect_text: You can hear people talking quietly inside. The smell of boiling cabbage and baked bread fills the air.

features.label: the cobblestone paving
features.inspect_text: Rounded river stones set into clay to make a clean, dry street through the town.

title: The Village Square
summary: A broad open square at the center of the underground village. A stone well sits in the middle, and an iron fire bowl provides warm yellow light.
inspect_text: Stone cottages crowd against the cavern walls. To the west is the village dining hall and elder's home. To the east, cart tracks lead toward the mana mines. To the north, a gated road leads to the soldier camp.

features.label: the iron fire bowl
features.inspect_text: A massive iron cauldron on three stone legs, filled with slow-burning peat that warms the center of town.

title: The Village Well
summary: A small plaza centered on a circular stone well that taps into an underground mountain stream.
inspect_text: A wooden crank and copper bucket let villagers haul up fresh, icy water. Women gather here to fill clay jugs.

features.label: the circular stone well
features.inspect_text: Deep stone masonry reaching down to cold, sweet subterranean water forty feet below.

title: The Stepped Mushroom Beds
summary: Stepped garden terraces cut into the cavern floor where villagers grow food in the dark. Thousands of thick mushrooms sprout from damp mulch beds.
inspect_text: A gentle mist falls from pipes in the ceiling. The garden smells of rich black soil and damp earth. Soft blue glow-caps provide just enough light to see rows of edible brown and gold fungi.

features.label: the glowing mushroom terraces
features.inspect_text: Raised rock beds filled with dark compost and decaying timber, covered in clusters of plump edible mushrooms.

title: South Mushroom Lane
summary: A quiet walkway bordering the southern edge of the mushroom gardens. Small stone sheds hold mulch and tools.
inspect_text: The smell of rich black soil is strongest here. Earthworms crawl in the compost beds along the wall.

features.label: the tool storage shed
features.inspect_text: A low shed holding wooden rakes, iron trowels, and watering pots for tending the fungus beds.

title: South Cave Ledge
summary: A high natural shelf offering a view of the southern cavern wall where natural mineral streaks sparkle like stars.
inspect_text: Faint trickles of water trace glistening lines down the black stone face. The space is quiet and peaceful.

features.label: the glistening mineral streaks
features.inspect_text: Bands of natural quartz and calcite embedded in the dark limestone that catch the candle glow.

title: Officer's Bunk
summary: A neat canvas tent with a cot and small footlocker for the camp lieutenants.
inspect_text: Polished leather boots and a spare helmet sit on a wooden stool. A ledger tracks daily guard duty rotations.

features.label: the officer's footlocker
features.inspect_text: A brass-hinged wooden box holding clean wool socks, a guard roster, and a short iron knife.

title: Guard Armory
summary: Racks of polished iron spears, shields painted red, and rows of heavy crossbows line the stone walls.
inspect_text: Armored suits stand on wooden mannequins. Iron weapon trunks line the floor, each secured with stout brass locks.

features.label: the weapon racks
features.inspect_text: Solid ash wood racks holding sharp iron spears and heavy military crossbows.

title: Drill Ground
summary: A wide patch of packed sand where soldiers spar with wooden practice swords and shields.
inspect_text: Deep footprints and scuff marks cover the arena. Racks of dulled wooden swords lean against the arena fence.

features.label: the wooden practice swords
features.inspect_text: Heavy ash wood clubs shaped like short swords, weighted with lead inserts.

title: Guard Camp Slope
summary: A steep rocky slope leading up toward the dark timber walls of the soldiers' fort.
inspect_text: Warning signs carved on wooden boards remind commoners not to approach the palisade without permission.

features.label: the wooden warning sign
features.inspect_text: A weather-beaten board painted with a red shield and the words: 'HALT - SOLDIERS ONLY'.

title: Miner Tool Shed
summary: An open wooden shed filled with replacement pick handles, shovel blades, and wooden wheelbarrows.
inspect_text: Sawdust covers the dirt floor. An old carpenter works on repairing a split wooden wheelbarrow.

features.label: the rack of pick handles
features.inspect_text: Smooth hickory handles shaved and oiled, ready to be fitted to iron pickaxe heads.

title: Lantern Lane
summary: A bustling lane where village traders spread cloth blankets to barter woven blankets, clay bowls, and salt.
inspect_text: Paper lanterns hang on strings across the street. Children run between the stalls playing tag.

features.label: the market trade blankets
features.inspect_text: Woven wool blankets laid out with handmade clay mugs, dried mushrooms, and carved wooden toys.

title: Weaver's Workshop
summary: A wide cottage where large wooden looms clack rhythmically. Baskets of spun mushroom fiber and sheep wool crowd the floor.
inspect_text: A weaver uses a wooden shuttle to thread dark blue yarn through a hanging frame. Tough work coats hang ready for sale.

features.label: the timber loom
features.inspect_text: A sturdy oak weaving frame strung with hundreds of tough gray cords made of cave fungus fiber.

title: Spore Drying Shed
summary: A warm timber shed with open lattice walls where mushroom spores and caps are dried on linen screens.
inspect_text: The air is warm and smells rich like roasted nuts. Wooden trays are stacked from floor to ceiling.

features.label: the drying screens
features.inspect_text: Square wooden frames covered with stretched cheesecloth, holding thousands of tiny drying spore clusters.

title: Garden Compost Shed
summary: A large stone bin holding decaying wood chips, straw, and spent mushroom compost.
inspect_text: The compost generates natural heat, warming the southern corner of the village. The soil is dark and crumbly.

features.label: the steaming compost bin
features.inspect_text: A deep stone enclosure where decaying plant matter turns into rich soil for the crops.

title: Deep Village Storehouse
summary: A deep natural chamber used to store spare building stone, rolls of canvas, and wooden barrel staves.
inspect_text: Cobwebs hang from the ceiling in thick sheets. The room is quiet and undisturbed.

features.label: the stacks of building stone
features.inspect_text: Squarish blocks of limestone cut from the quarry, stacked ready for chimney and wall repairs.

title: Teleport Platform Approach
summary: A wide stone ramp leading up to the great magic archway. White runes carved along the curb pulse with pale light.
inspect_text: Heavy flagstones lead directly toward the teleportation gate. The air smells sharp like lightning before a summer storm.

features.label: the carved stone ramp
features.inspect_text: Smooth gray stones edged with glowing runes that brighten as you get closer to the gate.

title: The Guard Command Tent
summary: A large military tent inside the camp stockade. An iron desk holds maps of the caves, and a heavy iron chest sits chained to the center tent pole.
inspect_text: Red cloth banners hang from the tent frame. The room smells of lamp oil, roasted meat, and wet wool. In the corner, a loose floorboard covers the old drainage pipe. Chained to the center pole is a padlocked iron chest.

features.label: the chained iron chest
features.inspect_text: A heavy iron lockbox wrapped in chains. A keyhole on the front is shaped like a double circle. The Teleportation Scroll is locked inside.

title: The Guard Camp Gate
summary: A high wooden wall made of sharpened logs blocks the canyon road. Two guard towers look down over a heavy wooden gate barred with iron.
inspect_text: Bright torches burn in iron baskets on the wooden catwalks. Armored soldiers pace the wall with loaded crossbows. The gate is firmly locked, and the guards shout down to warn everyone away.

features.label: the heavy barred gate
features.inspect_text: Thick wooden doors reinforced with black iron plates. A heavy iron bar holds them shut from the inside.

title: Camp Approach Road
summary: A wide dirt road running north toward the heavy gates of the Guard Camp.
inspect_text: Wheel ruts from supply wagons cut deep into the ground. Torchlight from the guard towers flickers overhead.

features.label: the deep wagon ruts
features.inspect_text: Hardened clay grooves worn by heavy wagons carrying iron, food, and mining gear to the soldiers.

title: East Village Fork
summary: A three-way fork in the cobblestone road. Signs point west to the square and east toward the mines.
inspect_text: Miners with dusty faces and iron buckets pass by, returning from their ten-hour digging shifts.

features.label: the wooden direction signs
features.inspect_text: A painted post pointing west toward 'Town Square' and east toward 'Mana Quarry'.

title: Mine Crossing Road
summary: A wide stone-paved road connecting the village directly to the mine works. Heavy wooden carts rumble past.
inspect_text: The air begins to smell of stone dust and sharp static electricity. A wooden arch marks the entrance to the mining zone.

features.label: the timber entrance arch
features.inspect_text: A stout archway made of squared mine timbers, carved with the crossed pickaxe badge of the diggers.

title: Miner Cottage Row East
summary: Stone houses built along the eastern cliff. Children play with smooth crystal pebbles on the doorsteps.
inspect_text: The ground here is tinged slightly violet from dust carried on the boots of returning family members.

features.label: the crystal pebbles
features.inspect_text: Small round stones with faint purple veins, gathered by children from the quarry wash.

title: Low Path to Lower Mines
summary: A sloped dirt track running down toward the lower crushers and tailings piles.
inspect_text: Miners wearing thick leather aprons carry baskets of raw rock up toward the processing sheds.

features.label: the sloped dirt track
features.inspect_text: A wide ramp packed hard by boots and wheelbarrows, dusted with fine white rock powder.

title: Village Root Cellar
summary: A cool, dry cave room lined with wooden bins holding stored turnips, pickled mushrooms, and dried roots.
inspect_text: The village keeps its winter emergency food here. The air smells of earth, vinegar, and dry straw.

features.label: the food storage bins
features.inspect_text: Deep slatted pine bins filled with sweet yellow turnips and dried fungus cakes.

title: Southern Runoff Trench
summary: A stone trench cut into the floor to funnel runoff water out of the village toward the lower mine sluices.
inspect_text: Water rushes steadily down the channel, carrying loose dirt and fine sand toward the quarry drainage.

features.label: the stone runoff trench
features.inspect_text: A two-foot-wide gutter paved with smooth river pebbles, directing village wastewater away from living areas.

title: The Teleportation Gate
summary: A huge circular stone archway built against the back cave wall. Carved white runes glow with bright light and emit a deep electrical hum.
inspect_text: This is the only way up to Floor 5. The white stone ring stands twenty feet high, crackling with raw magical energy. A stone pedestal in front of the gate has a circular slot for a teleportation spell.

features.label: the glowing stone archway
features.inspect_text: A massive ring of carved white marble. Ribbons of pale light swirl inside the opening, humming with power.

title: Upper Camp Courtyard
summary: An open gravel yard between the command tent and the prison cage. Torches flicker in iron wall brackets.
inspect_text: Patrols cross here frequently as they rotate between watch posts. The ground is packed hard by hundreds of iron-shod boots.

features.label: the iron wall torches
features.inspect_text: Heavy iron sconces holding pitch-soaked torches that cast dancing yellow shadows across the gravel.

title: Lower Camp Courtyard
summary: The inner yard just behind the main gate. Wagons are unloaded here and inspection lines are formed.
inspect_text: Wheel ruts groove the dirt. Guards check passes and inspect crates brought in from the village.

features.label: the wagon wheel ruts
features.inspect_text: Deep wagon ruts pressed into the clay floor, dried hard by the warm cave air.

title: The Old Drain Pipe
summary: A narrow, low tunnel lined with cracked clay tiles. Cold water trickles over your boots, running north under the stone foundations of the guard camp.
inspect_text: You have to crouch low to move through the pipe. Slimy green moss covers the damp clay walls. Up ahead, faint light and the sound of soldiers' voices leak through a loose wooden floor hatch.

features.label: the wooden floor hatch
features.inspect_text: Square wooden planks in the ceiling above. You can smell lamp oil and hear heavy boots pacing back and forth above you.

exits.label: Climb through Hatch into Guard Camp

title: Flooded Culvert
summary: A knee-deep water channel running between the village runoff and the mine drainage. Water splashes over slippery flagstones.
inspect_text: A rusty iron grate in the north wall leads into the old drain pipe. The air is cool and smells of mineral salts.

features.label: the rusty iron grate
features.inspect_text: An iron grate whose lower bars have rotted through from years of mineral-rich water, leaving room to slip through.

title: The Mine Entrance
summary: A wide archway cut into the rock wall where the village road meets the excavation tunnels. Sturdy timber beams frame the tunnel mouth.
inspect_text: The air is cool, dry, and smells of pulverized stone and static electricity. Iron tracks disappear into the darkness ahead, and glowing purple crystal seams trace veins across the ceiling.

features.label: the timber entrance frame
features.inspect_text: Massive square oak beams braced with iron plates to keep the tunnel mouth from collapsing.

title: Ore Sorting Shed
summary: A long open-sided shed where miners use hand hammers to break rock away from raw mana crystals.
inspect_text: Chipped crystal shards fill wooden sorting tubs labeled by purity. The room glows with mixed hues of sapphire and amethyst.

features.label: the sorting tubs
features.inspect_text: Wooden crates filled with graded crystal chunks: dull purple for village lamps, bright blue for high-level spells.

title: Stone Crusher Floor
summary: Two massive iron stampers driven by overhead water ropes rise and drop onto stone slabs, crushing ore into gravel.
inspect_text: The pounding rhythm shakes the stone under your boots: *CRUNCH... CRUNCH*. Fine dust covers everything in a gray blanket.

features.label: the iron ore stampers
features.inspect_text: Hundreds of pounds of cast iron rising and slamming down to break stone away from stubborn crystal nuggets.

title: Lower Rail Spur
summary: A quiet spur track leading into the lower storage tunnels. Old carts with missing wheels sit on the sidelines.
inspect_text: Grease cans and oily rags litter an upturned barrel. A track hand works on tightening loose rail spikes.

features.label: the loose rail switch
features.inspect_text: A hand-forged iron lever that shifts the rail tracks between the main drift and the repair yard.

title: Runoff Sluice
summary: A wide wooden flume that carries wastewater from both the village and the mine crushers toward the south chasm.
inspect_text: The water rushes fast and loud over smooth timber boards. Thick safety ropes are strung along the sides.

features.label: the rushing water flume
features.inspect_text: A stout wooden trough carrying three feet of swiftly flowing water south into the abyss.

title: Priest's Pavilion
summary: A white silk pavilion decorated with silver eye symbols. Incense burns in bronze censers, smelling of dry flowers and wax.
inspect_text: Priest Malas stays here while waiting to claim the village offering. Velvet pillows rest on a wool rug, surrounded by quiet candle stands.

features.label: the silver eye banner
features.inspect_text: A silver flag embroidered with the unblinking eye of the temple priests, watching over the camp.

title: The Prison Cage
summary: A courtyard behind high wooden walls. An iron cage hangs from heavy chains over a dry stone pit, guarded by torchlight.
inspect_text: The cage is made of thick square iron bars. Inside, an eleven-year-old boy in dusty work clothes sits on the cold floor, glaring fiercely through the bars. Two guards stand nearby, keeping watch.

features.label: the hanging iron cage
features.inspect_text: A heavy iron cage suspended ten feet off the ground over a rocky pit. The door is locked with a heavy steel padlock.

title: Sentry Guardhouse
summary: A low stone building where gate guards stay on duty. A desk holds the village passbook and iron keys.
inspect_text: A small iron gate opens into a holding cell where rowdy miners spend the night before being kicked back out.

features.label: the gate passbook
features.inspect_text: A thick leather book recording every cart of ore and visitor entering the camp.

title: Mine Drainage Pump
summary: A clanking mechanical pump powered by an iron water wheel. Wooden pistons pump sludge out of the low tunnels.
inspect_text: The noise is deafening: *thump-clank... thump-clank*. Wet sludge splashes into a flume that empties into the drainage network.

features.label: the wooden pump pistons
features.inspect_text: Heavy oak beams linked to an iron crank, rising and falling with rhythmic mechanical force.

title: Mine Cart Staging Depot
summary: A wide junction where multiple iron rail lines merge into a turntable. Empty wooden ore carts wait in neat rows.
inspect_text: Grease pots and iron levers sit by the track switch. A blackboard lists the daily cart quotas for each mining crew.

features.label: the iron rail turntable
features.inspect_text: A revolving steel disc set into the floor that allows heavy carts to turn and change tracks easily.

title: The Cart Tracks
summary: A double line of iron rails runs down the center of this broad tunnel. Empty wooden ore carts sit on side spurs waiting to be loaded.
inspect_text: Lanterns hang from ceiling timbers every twenty paces. Miners shout to each other over the clinking of iron picks and the rumble of iron cart wheels.

features.label: the wooden ore cart
features.inspect_text: A four-wheeled wagon built from thick oak planks and bound in iron bands. A hand brake lever sits near the front axle.

title: Quarry Pit Rim
summary: The upper edge of the great excavation pit. A heavy timber guardrail prevents workers from falling into the deep quarry below.
inspect_text: Looking down, you can see dozens of miners working by torchlight thirty feet beneath you. Winch ropes hang over the rim.

features.label: the pit guardrail
features.inspect_text: Heavy oak rails secured to iron posts anchored in the rock, guarding the edge of the pit.

title: Pit Winch Station
summary: A heavy wooden winch frame wound with thick hemp ropes. Iron hooks raise and lower ore buckets into the quarry pit.
inspect_text: Two strong miners turn the iron hand cranks. A leather brake shoe squeals as a loaded bucket reaches the top.

features.label: the heavy hemp winch
features.inspect_text: A giant oak drum wrapped in two-inch hemp rope, capable of lifting half a ton of crystal ore.

title: Rock Tailing Dump
summary: A natural ravine where miners dump barren rock that contains no mana crystals.
inspect_text: Dust rises in plumes as a wheelbarrow of gravel is tipped over the wooden lip into the dark gap.

features.label: the dumping chute
features.inspect_text: A slanted plank chute worn slick by millions of falling stones pouring into the chasm.

title: The Deepest Cut
summary: The deepest active excavation trench in the quarry. Huge stepped rock benches descend forty feet below the main floor.
inspect_text: The crystals here are darker and more concentrated, glowing deep royal indigo. The air is warm and heavy with power.

features.label: the royal indigo crystals
features.inspect_text: Dense, dark crystal clusters that pulse with immense raw energy, stored deep in the earth.

title: East Rampart Walk
summary: An elevated wooden walk along the eastern ramparts. Below, you can see the top of the crystal mine pits.
inspect_text: Guards patrol here day and night to ensure no miners try to sneak out with stolen mana crystals.

features.label: the guard lookout ledge
features.inspect_text: A high wooden railing where soldiers lean and watch the eastern mine tunnels below.

title: East Soldier Barracks
summary: A second sleeping hall for the eastern garrison. Racks of dry boots sit near a warm iron stove.
inspect_text: Footlockers are shoved under bunks. Shield coats and red cloaks hang from wooden pegs along the timber wall.

features.label: the iron heating stove
features.inspect_text: A pot-bellied cast-iron stove that vents smoke up through a tin pipe into the high cavern ceiling.

title: Palisade Timber Yard
summary: Stacks of fresh pine logs and cedar poles used to repair the fort walls and mine shoring.
inspect_text: The air smells of pine resin and saw chips. Two-man crosscut saws hang on wooden pegs under a tarp.

features.label: the stack of pine logs
features.inspect_text: Straight pine trunks seasoned and debarked, ready to replace rotten palisade sections.

title: North Ventilation Shaft
summary: A high vertical chimney cut into the rock ceiling. Fresh, cold air rushes down from upper levels, cooling the humid quarry.
inspect_text: A canvas wind-sail hangs suspended on iron ropes, catching air and directing it into the deeper tunnels.

features.label: the canvas wind-sail
features.inspect_text: Heavy sailcloth stretched over an iron hoop, channeling a steady stream of crisp surface air downward.

title: Heavy Timber Support Hall
summary: Massive oak archways support the cracked cavern ceiling here. The timbers creak softly under the weight of the stone above.
inspect_text: Wedges of cedar are hammered into every joint. Miners pass through this corridor quickly, keeping their eyes on the ceiling.

features.label: the creaking oak timbers
features.inspect_text: Foot-thick square oak beams bolted together with iron bands, holding back thousands of tons of fractured stone.

title: Main Haulage Tunnel
summary: The busiest tunnel in the quarry. Two lines of tracks allow loaded carts to roll west while empty carts return east.
inspect_text: Miners push heavy carts with their shoulders down, their faces coated in blue-gray stone powder. The air hums with crystal energy.

features.label: the iron cart rails
features.inspect_text: Twin steel bars spiked to wooden ties, polished bright and shiny by hundreds of rolling cart wheels.

title: The Crystal Pit
summary: A huge natural cave with a deep pit in the middle. Giant clusters of glowing purple and blue mana crystals stick out from the rock walls like jagged glass.
inspect_text: The air crackles with magic that makes your skin tingle. Bright purple light reflects off wet stone walls. Down in the pit, miners use hand chisels to crack free glowing chunks of crystal.

features.label: the glowing mana crystals
features.inspect_text: Thick spikes of purple crystal that pulse with cold inner light. They store pure magic and power the machines of the upper floors.

title: Golem Excavation Floor
summary: A deep stone chamber where an old, moss-dusted stone golem works silently, lifting rocks three times heavier than a human could move.
inspect_text: Orin the golem stands patient and still between lifting boulders. His stone eyes are dim and foggy, waiting for someone with enough wisdom to wake his mind.

features.label: the silent stone golem
features.inspect_text: A massive humanoid carved from gray granite, banded with iron rings. He works without complaining, his mind clouded by age.

title: Deep Mine Sump
summary: The lowest point of the quarry pit. Water collects here in a black pool before being pumped back to the surface.
inspect_text: A wooden raft floats in the center with an intake pipe. The water is cold and clear, reflecting the violet glow of the walls above.

features.label: the floating pump raft
features.inspect_text: A buoyant platform made of sealed barrels and planks holding the suction mouth of the drainage pump.

title: Abyssal Rock Fault
summary: A massive natural fissure where the cave floor splits into a bottomless chasm. Wind howls up from the deep earth.
inspect_text: A rope bridge crosses the narrowest gap, connecting to the southern crystal pockets. The drop below is pitch black.

features.label: the abyss rope bridge
features.inspect_text: A swaying bridge of braided rope and split pine planks spanning the dizzying dark crevasse.

title: Signal Fire Platform
summary: A stone platform built on the highest rock pillar. A stack of dry pitch-soaked logs waits ready for a beacon fire.
inspect_text: If miners riot or beasts break in, this fire signals the guards on the upper floors. An iron gong hangs beside the wood pile.

features.label: the signal gong
features.inspect_text: A heavy bronze disc struck with an iron hammer to sound camp-wide alarms.

title: Camp Supply Store
summary: A large tent packed with sacks of grain, barrels of salted fish, coils of rope, and spare iron nails.
inspect_text: Supplies for a three-month siege are stored here under guard. The air smells of salt, dried apples, and canvas.

features.label: the grain sacks and barrels
features.inspect_text: Burlap sacks stamped with the royal crest, stacked neatly five high on wooden pallets.

title: Pack-Beast Stable
summary: A fenced corral with hay mangers where thick-furred cave mules rest after hauling heavy wagons.
inspect_text: The mules chew silently on dry hay. The yard smells of sweet grass, manure, and leather harness oil.

features.label: the wooden hay mangers
features.inspect_text: Long wooden troughs filled with dried prairie hay brought down from the surface.

title: Blasting Powder Store
summary: A heavily reinforced vault behind thick oak doors. Red barrels of mineral blasting powder sit on dry wooden racks.
inspect_text: Warning symbols of a bursting rock are painted on the doors. A brass lock keeps unauthorized workers out.

features.label: the powder barrels
features.inspect_text: Stout oak kegs sealed with black pitch, holding fine volcanic sulfur powder for breaking hard rock.

title: Bright Violet Vein
summary: A stunning wall of solid violet mana crystals exposed by recent excavation. The crystals glow with steady cold light.
inspect_text: The light is bright enough to read by without a candle. You can feel a faint vibration in your teeth as magic pulses through the rock.

features.label: the solid violet crystal vein
features.inspect_text: A continuous ribbon of pure purple crystal three feet wide, pulsing with natural magical electricity.

title: Chiseled Stone Gallery
summary: A high vaulted gallery where stone masons have chiseled away the surrounding slate to expose giant crystal pillars.
inspect_text: Pillars of translucent blue and violet crystal stand ten feet tall, glowing like frozen icebergs in the gloom.

features.label: the glowing crystal pillars
features.inspect_text: Spectacular natural columns of pure mana crystal that illuminate the entire chamber with azure light.

title: Deep Mana Crystal Seam
summary: A massive deposit of blue and purple crystals cutting through dark granite. The rock seems to hum like a living creature.
inspect_text: Whenever a chisel strikes the wall, rings of soft light ripple through the crystal clusters. The magic here is thick and potent.

features.label: the humming crystal cluster
features.inspect_text: A dense cluster of blue crystals that vibrates with a faint, pleasant musical note when tapped.

title: Blue Crystal Pocket
summary: A hollow geode chamber inside the rock wall. The entire interior is lined with sparkling cobalt-blue crystals.
inspect_text: The air is cool and smells clean like mountain snow. Stepping inside feels like walking into an underground sky full of blue stars.

features.label: the cobalt crystal geode
features.inspect_text: A natural spherical pocket lined with thousands of deep blue crystal points that catch and bend the light.

title: Submerged Rail Drift
summary: An old mine tunnel where groundwater has risen six inches above the iron tracks, creating a flooded hallway.
inspect_text: Your boots splash through cold, crystal-clear water. Abandoned iron picks rest against the wet stone wall.

features.label: the flooded rail tracks
features.inspect_text: Iron rails running under clear water, rippling with violet reflections from crystals on the ceiling.

title: Geode Floor
summary: A flat stone room where the floor itself is made of solid, polished crystal. Walking here feels like standing on frozen violet glass.
inspect_text: Your boots make high ringing sounds against the hard crystal floor. Faint geometric patterns crisscross beneath the surface.

features.label: the crystalline floor
features.inspect_text: A naturally polished sheet of solid quartz and mana crystal, perfectly flat and glowing with internal light.

title: Northeast Watchtower
summary: A sturdy timber tower looking down into the eastern mine chasms and cart rails.
inspect_text: From up here, the whole mine looks like a web of blue and purple lights. Crossbow quivers hang from every corner post.

features.label: the corner tower posts
features.inspect_text: Heavy pine pillars notched and pegged together to withstand cave tremors.

title: East Stockade Wall
summary: A high timber wall overlooking the rocky eastern ravine. Heavy support beams brace the log palisade.
inspect_text: The cliff drops steeply on the other side. A small sentry booth keeps the rain of condensation off the guard on watch.

features.label: the sentry shelter
features.inspect_text: A tiny timber shack with a sloped shingle roof where a guard stands out of the damp.

title: Southeast Watchtower
summary: A tall wooden tower guarding the corner where the camp wall meets the eastern mine boundary.
inspect_text: A large iron alarm bell hangs from the timber crossbeam, overlooking the entire lower valley.

features.label: the iron alarm bell
features.inspect_text: A big iron bell cast with warning runes, ready to ring if trouble breaks out in the mines.

title: High Crystal Drift
summary: A narrow exploration drift following a thin seam of sparkling amethyst crystals.
inspect_text: Chisel marks cover every inch of the wall. Tiny purple sparks jump between crystal needles when you brush against them.

features.label: the needle crystal seam
features.inspect_text: Thin, razor-sharp needles of violet crystal clustering along a narrow fault line in the stone.

title: Ore Loading Chute
summary: A sloped wooden chute built against a cliff face. Workers above tip wheelbarrows of raw crystal ore down into waiting carts below.
inspect_text: Rock chunks clatter down the wooden slide with a sound like thunder. A thick cloud of white stone dust hangs in the air.

features.label: the wooden ore chute
features.inspect_text: A long slide lined with sheet iron so rock chunks slide smoothly down into the haulage carts.

title: East Crystal Stope
summary: A stepped excavation room cutting upward into the eastern rock wall. Scaffolding ladders climb twenty feet to working faces.
inspect_text: Miners on the ladders chip away at crystal clusters with small copper chisels, catching the falling shards in canvas aprons.

features.label: the timber scaffolding
features.inspect_text: Multi-level wooden frames lashed with rawhide, allowing miners to reach high veins safely.

title: Shored-Up Drift
summary: A tunnel that partially collapsed during a tremor months ago, now reinforced with double rows of timber props.
inspect_text: Loose rubble has been cleared to the sides. Warning marks chalked on the ceiling warn diggers to keep vibration low.

features.label: the chalk warning marks
features.inspect_text: White chalk circles indicating fractured ceiling rock that could drop if hit with heavy hammers.

title: Crushed Rock Tailings
summary: A sloping hill of crushed white quartz and discarded stone tailings dumped from the processing rooms above.
inspect_text: Small pieces of low-grade crystal still glint in the rubble pile. The gravel crunches loudly underfoot.

features.label: the pile of crushed tailings
features.inspect_text: Pounds of shattered quartz gravel left over after the valuable mana crystals have been picked clean.

title: Crystal Seep Tunnel
summary: A narrow, winding tunnel where water seeps through crystal-encrusted cracks in the ceiling.
inspect_text: Mineral water drips continuously: *plip... plip... plip*. Delicate crystal stalactites hang down like icy fingers.

features.label: the crystal stalactites
features.inspect_text: Hanging points of pure purple crystal formed over centuries by mineral-rich water dripping from the roof.

title: Quiet Crystal Grotto
summary: A peaceful hidden chamber far from the noise of pickaxes and ore carts. Giant sapphire-blue crystals form a natural circle.
inspect_text: A calm pool of water in the center reflects the gentle blue light. Miners come here on their breaks to rest and breathe easy.

features.label: the circular crystal ring
features.inspect_text: A natural ring of blue crystal spires standing like silent guardians around a still reflective pool.
